input.subject: Monkey D. Luffy
input.intent: Generate a complete executable Manga Mayhem tower-defense unit for the Straw Hat roster. Role: captain and flexible carry. Preserve manga/anime traits, named techniques, personality and Wano-era continuity. Provide explicit base stats, targeting, attacks, abilities, resources, statuses, forms, lifecycle rules, and 15 concrete purchasable upgrades across 3 paths with exact costs and operations. Use game numbers only as declared adaptations. Do not invent powers to fill slots; deepen sourced abilities and disclose omissions. Respect the crew balance rules.

context.researchRule: Use only fresh research returned for this request; do not rely on prior generated candidates.

research.subject: Monkey D. Luffy
gaps: No specific continuity title was supplied: the continuity field contains a reporting instruction. Original serialized manga continuity and an end-of-Wano cutoff are explicit selection assumptions, not a verbatim caller-specified continuity name.

The character-specific source is an abilities subpage with an embedded identity profile, not a separately supplied main biography. It is sufficient to identify Luffy, but the search listing alone would not resolve him.

Both supplied captures were considered through their ends, including references and navigation. Both report acquisitionTruncated=false. No linked technique pages, manga chapters, images or referenced publications were independently supplied or inspected.

The abilities page mixes manga, anime, video-game and later-arc information. Anime-only Afro Luffy recurrence and orange Armament aura, Unlimited Cruise Nightmare Luffy archery and sake-fueled fireballs, and prototype Romance Dawn navigation entries are excluded from the selected character record.

Egghead and Elbaph feats are outside the selected temporal scope. This excludes Emet communication, later opponents and alleged later Haki applications or immunities, including the supplied Domi Reversi statement. Their presence does not make Luffy's identity ambiguous.
Later localized Gear 4 use and some general statements about reduced Gear drawbacks are not clearly dated to Wano in the capture; they are not accepted as established Wano-era capabilities.

The request for an executable tower-defense unit, flexible-carry role, exact base stats, targeting rules, resources, statuses, lifecycle operations and fifteen purchasable upgrades is not character evidence. No such game implementation or numerical adaptations are included in this independent evidence record.
roster.json, crew balance rules, engine schema and economy specifications were not supplied. Their contents cannot be verified or inferred from the character pages.

The supplied source links out to main, Gear 2, Gear 3, Gear 4 and Gear 5 technique pages without including their contents. A complete named-move catalog, exact attack parameters and named Gear 5 finishers cannot be recovered from this capture alone.
Gear 1 appears only in a speculative Fandom quick answer that acknowledges the term is not explicitly established. It is not accepted as a verified named transformation.

The overview does not supply a detailed Gear 5 exhaustion cycle, exact duration, restart conditions or reproducible resurrection rule. Its awakening after apparent death does not establish general immortality.

The source's expansive imagination-to-reality language is retained only as attributed secondary-source characterization. It does not justify inventing powers, unlimited reality manipulation, solar attacks or immunity to all damage.

The page's blanket wording about ordinary blunt immunity must be read alongside its documented injuries and Haki exceptions. Its poison-immunity wording is explicitly limited by the Stonefish and Mummy counterexamples.
The capture mentions inflation preventing sinking, but does not provide a complete account of swimming inability, immersion thresholds or seawater mechanics. Such details are not added from memory.

Nightmare Luffy's blue appearance is stated by the page, but its associated reference metadata appears inconsistent and includes anime-specific color evidence. Color is not relied upon for the manga-only record.

The historical Paramecia label and Wano Mythical Zoan revelation are treated as an in-story reclassification, not two simultaneously possessed fruits. Navigation lists are not used to assign unrelated characters' powers to Luffy.
No unsupported memory claims, caller-invented character concepts or assertions of independently verified official canon are included.

identity.explanation: The supplied character-specific Abilities and Powers page identifies Monkey D. Luffy, his Chapter 1 debut, Straw Hat captaincy and manga-referenced abilities. The ONE PIECE.com page is a character-search listing and provides corroboration, not independent character resolution. The input continuity field is a request to report supported continuity rather than a named continuity string. Original serialized manga continuity is therefore selected explicitly, with Wano as the temporal scope suggested by the guidance. Anime-only, video-game, prototype and later-arc material is not merged into this record.

uncheckedRules: Numerical tuning, source fidelity and enjoyable play require review.

The runtime executes stationary direct contact, traveling projectiles and ally healing with caller-supplied motion and injury. The optional canonical mechanics block executes actors, projectile graphs, statuses, income and range support. Defensive combat and automatic moving-path simulation remain outside the adapter.

findings.message: Pulse and emission cycles count successful primary attack cycles required for one trigger, not waves per trigger. A cycle counts once when at least one primary hit applies positive damage, regardless of collateral targets. Pulses apply stun without damage; their event amount counts affected targets. Emissions apply their declared damage. Pulse intervals can further limit trigger frequency.
